title: Portable mutable local dependency roots
purpose: 여러 프로젝트의 가변 로컬 의존성이 호스트마다 다른 루트에 있어도 manifest의 각 의존 경로를 다시 쓰지 않고 찾는다.
question: What existing solution can provide portable named base directories for mutable local package dependencies, so manifests keep stable relative paths while each developer or external build system supplies its own root?

mandatory_predicates.predicate: Dependency manifest refers to a named root plus relative path; an external per-user/per-project configuration resolves the root.
Resolution is usable for mutable local dependency sources, not only immutable versioned registry copies.
Moving a shared root or using a different host does not require editing every dependency path in every manifest.
An unknown required base is diagnosed; ordinary path dependencies retain their existing resolution without a base.

preferred: Explicit dependency rather than implicit global search path
scope_reason: Takes the whole feature proposed in Summary, including host indirection and dependency resolution, rather than an individual parser step.

title: Source-path remapping inside compilation
purpose: 컴파일 단위에서 생성되는 소스 경로를 안정된 이름으로 바꾸어 바이너리의 사적 절대경로를 줄이고 사용자 지정 매핑을 우선한다.
question: What existing compiler or build component can implement the source-path remapping step: convert compilation-generated absolute source roots into stable paths in output, include debug/file-macro paths, and let explicit user mappings override generated defaults without rewriting arbitrary string literals?

mandatory_predicates.predicate: Map compilation-generated absolute source roots to stable relative or virtual identifiers in output.
The path-remapping boundary includes source locations in debug information and file/include macro paths.
mandatory_predicates.source_section: Motivation L16-18; Reference L113-118; Drawbacks L141-143

mandatory_predicates.predicate: Explicit user prefix mappings take precedence over automatically supplied mappings.
The remapping step is not a general rewrite of hard-coded strings in source.

relations: emits default mapping for each compilation unit
scope_reason: Only the remapping step in Reference L105-124 is requested. The draft separately proposes profile defaults and changed sysroot lookup behavior; those entire-system decisions are outside this partial question.

title: Authenticated private package distribution
purpose: 비공개 패키지의 index·다운로드·API를 인증하면서 초기 설정 조회의 인증 순환과 재시도·리다이렉트 유출 경계를 처리한다.
question: What existing package distribution design can support authenticated private registries across the index, downloads and API, including discovering authentication before config is readable, safe token forwarding, and reusable credentials without a bootstrap cycle?

mandatory_predicates.predicate: Configured authorization applies coherently to registry API, package downloads and HTTP index requests.
mandatory_predicates.source_section: Summary L7; Guide L15; Reference L29

mandatory_predicates.predicate: The initial protected config request can bootstrap by retrying a 401 with credentials or by explicit local preauthentication.
Redirect following does not forward the authorization token to the redirect target.
Tokens are only sent over HTTPS or localhost; insecure remote transport is rejected.
Credential lookup can use the index URL before config is read and can reuse credentials across repeated requests.

preferred: Do not repeatedly call the credential helper
relations: keys credential lookup before API URL discovery
scope_reason: Asks for an alternative to the full proposed private-registry authorization design, including its bootstrap and security boundary.

title: Conditional feature forwarding without dependency activation
initial_sections: Dependency features in features table L127-153
purpose: 상위 feature가 요청되었을 때 optional dependency를 새로 활성화하지 않고, 다른 feature로 이미 활성화된 dependency의 필요한 하위 feature만 전달한다.
question: What existing reusable component or design can forward a requested feature to an optional dependency only when that dependency is independently enabled, without the forwarding request itself activating the dependency?

mandatory_predicates.predicate: A parent feature request alone must not enable the optional dependency merely to forward a feature.
mandatory_predicates.source_section: Weak dependency use cases L29-45; Dependency features L141-142

mandatory_predicates.predicate: When the optional dependency is independently enabled and the parent feature is requested, the specified child feature is enabled on that dependency.

scope_reason: The initial draft combines weak dependency forwarding, feature/dependency namespaces, registry index changes and resolver migration. This question selects only the weak-forwarding behavior in L29-45 and L127-153.
